newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends steady, awaits swaps, cargo fate.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends steady, awaits swaps, cargo fate.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended steady to slightly lower on Monday as traders awaited the fate of the swaps market and several Med cargoes.

Several players were noted buyers in the Feb swaps again on Monday, extending last week's gains but in a lighter manner, traders said. Swaps were expected to buoy the cash market unless or until these buyers turn sellers.
Feb swaps were last assessed up slightly at $229/$229.50 a tonne, and widened the spread against March and April from Friday's levels.
Cargoes were notionally seen at $224/$228 cif for NWE.
